title: 30A East Lakeside Villa Inlet Beach, FL Stay at 30A Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Lakefront Retreat!* Directly on Camp Creek Lake – Enjoy lakefront living just minutes from the Gulf* 5 Complimentary Bikes*...
description_expanded: Overview5.0(1 review)Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Lakefront Retreat!* Directly on Camp Creek Lake – Enjoy lakefront living just minutes from the Gulf* 5 Complimentary Bikes* Pet Friendly (add'l $200 fee)* Beach Chairs, Umbrellas and Toys Included * Private Dock – Fish, relax, or launch a kayak or paddleboard right from the back dock, 2 Kayaks and 2 Paddleboards Included * Paddle to the Beach – Reach a quiet private beach in approximately 10–15 minutes by paddle* Outdoor Shower* 10-Minute Walk to Public Beach Access – Easy walk or bike ride* 3 Minutes to The Big Chill * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **Please Note: Lakeside Villa is the lower floor of a two-level cabin and is one of two individual rental units. Your reservation is for Lakeside Villa only. The second unit may be occupied during your stay. Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.*Welcome to Lakeside Villa, a peaceful lakefront lower floor retreat offering something truly special along 30A—direct access to Camp Creek Lake wake up to still water and peaceful lake views, then start your morning with coffee on the deck or dock. Launch a kayak or paddleboard and explore the coastal dune lake, then relax on the lakeside deck, enjoy the beach gear, or rinse off in the outdoor shower. From breakfast by the water to sunset views, Lakeside Villa makes enjoying the outdoors effortless. Inside features two bedrooms and one bathroom, comfortably sleeps up to five guests. Large windows and the balcony overlook Camp Creek Lake. The comfortable layout includes a Queen bed in the master bedroom, two Twin beds in the guest bedroom, and a Twin sleeper sofa in the living area. Lakeside Villa is the perfect place to slow down and experience 30A from a different perspective.The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin BedsLiving Area: Twin Sleeper SofaArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Show less
